timeline.content:
Call Summary — Richard Bancroft — May 18, 2026 — 22 min

Prospect confirmed he is away from the Greenwich property approximately 8 months per year, primarily based in Manhattan but also spends time in London for work. He acknowledged that vendor coordination has been a recurring frustration — had two separate incidents last winter where contractors were not properly supervised, resulting in a flooded utility room and a missed HVAC inspection.

He was receptive to the AVM model but asked pointed questions about pricing transparency — specifically wanted to know whether the monthly fee includes emergency response or if that's billed separately. He also asked whether AVM handles billing directly with vendors or passes invoices through to the owner.

He mentioned he had spoken with one other property management firm (did not name them) and found their contract "opaque." He would like to see a sample monthly statement before moving forward. He described the property as "a significant asset I'm not currently protecting properly."

Action items discussed: Send sample monthly report, send rate card with full fee breakdown, follow up in 2 weeks.

draft_email.subject: Your new property at 5 Mountain Laurel Rd — a thought
draft_email.body:
Dear Mr. Davenport,

Congratulations on your recent acquisition at 5 Mountain Laurel Rd in Wilton. It's a beautiful property in one of Fairfield County's most sought-after neighborhoods.

I noticed the home was purchased through a New York address — which tells me you may be managing it remotely. If that's the case, I wanted to introduce AVM Concierge, a property management service built specifically for owners like you: people who own exceptional properties in Connecticut and Westchester, but who aren't there every day to oversee them.

We handle everything from vendor relationships to seasonal maintenance to emergency response — all for a flat monthly fee with complete transparency on every invoice. Our clients tell us the thing they value most is never having to take a call about a leaking roof when they're in a board meeting.

I'd love to tell you more. Would you be open to a 15-minute call this week or next?

Warm regards,
Sarah Morgan
Client Development — AVM Concierge
(203) 555-0142
